cadenas.es: Autónomo viable si empiezas solo, SL si hay socios
cadenas.propuesta_en: An LLC separates personal and business liability and suits partners. An S corp election can cut self-employment tax once profit is steady; ask your accountant when it pays off.
File your LLC with the Secretary of State and appoint a registered agent
File the articles of organization and sign an operating agreement, even for a single-member LLC. Filing fees and processing times vary by state; check the state website.
Get your EIN from the IRS and register for state payroll and unemployment tax

cadenas.es: Epígrafe IAE: 672.x (servicios de restauración en quioscos, food trucks e instalaciones móviles análogas) o 677.9 (venta ambulante sin elaboración) — la elección la valida tu gestor según si elaboras el producto en el vehículo o sólo lo vendes
cadenas.propuesta_en: Apply once the state approves your LLC. The EIN is free and takes minutes online at irs.gov. Register with your state workforce agency before your first hire, so your payroll provider can file from day one.
Open a business bank account and keep finances separate

cadenas.es: Cuota según la base mínima del tramo que te corresponda. Consulta el importe del ejercicio en curso y verifica con tu gestoría si te aplica la cuota reducida de inicio de actividad
cadenas.propuesta_en: Bring your EIN letter and formation documents. Keep a card for purchases and a separate account for deposits, so event deposits never mix with personal money.
Get a seller's permit and register for state sales tax
In many states sales tax applies to the whole catering invoice: food, staff and rentals. Confirm your state's rule and whether service charges are taxed before you quote.
Apply for the city or county business license (and a DBA if you use a trade name)
Check every city where you plan to cater: some require a license to operate there. A DBA (fictitious business name) is filed with the county or state.

cadenas.es: Inscripción en el Registro Sanitario de tu Comunidad Autónoma (declaración responsable de inicio de actividad alimentaria)
cadenas.propuesta_en: Hire an accountant or bookkeeper and set up quarterly estimated taxes

cadenas.es: El Registro General Sanitario estatal NO aplica al minorista que sirve al consumidor final (art. 2.2 del RD 191/2011): el que te toca es el autonómico, el mismo que pide la fase 2 de este checklist con la autorización sanitaria del vehículo
cadenas.propuesta_en: Ask for catering experience. Estimated taxes are due quarterly; put a share of every deposit into a tax savings account so the bill never surprises you.
Choose catering software for proposals, contracts, deposits and invoices
One tool should send the quote, collect the e-signature and take the deposit by card or ACH. Test it with a mock proposal before you pay for a full year.
Have an attorney draft your standard catering contract
Cover deposit, cancellation and postponement terms, guest minimum, final guest count date, and service charge versus gratuity. Reuse it for every event.

cadenas.propuesta_en: Get your Certified Food Protection Manager certificate (ServSafe Manager)

cadenas.es: El RD 1007/2023 y su calendario escalonado obligan a que el software de facturación sea verificable. Consulta la fecha que te aplica antes de comprar el TPV móvil y el datáfono que ya presupuesta la hoja de Inversión Inicial: cambiarlo después cuesta el doble
cadenas.propuesta_en: Most health departments require one certified manager. Take an ANSI-accredited exam and keep a copy for your permit file and for every event binder.
Choose a shared commissary kitchen: hours, cold and dry storage, van parking

cadenas.es: Furgoneta adaptada, remolque o trailer. Nuevo o 2a mano
cadenas.propuesta_en: Visit at least three. Compare peak-hour availability, walk-in space, parking for the van and the deposit. Ask whether the health department has approved the kitchen for catering.
Most health departments ask for it with the permit application. It should name your hours, storage areas, parking and cleaning duties; keep a signed copy on file.
Apply for the county catering / health permit

Many counties review your catering SOPs and charge a plan review fee before issuing the permit; a full plan review applies if you lease your own kitchen. Expect an application, a fee, a menu review and an inspection of the kitchen and the van.
Get temporary food event permits for community or public events

cadenas.es: Obligatorio si se modifica la carrocería
cadenas.propuesta_en: Your catering permit usually does not cover public or community events. Each event may need its own temporary food permit; apply well before the date.
Check fire marshal rules for open flame, chafing fuel and tents

cadenas.es: Planos de instalación, flujos y depósitos de agua
cadenas.propuesta_en: Rules depend on the venue and the city. Ask venues about open flame, fuel canisters and cooking under tents, and keep fire extinguishers on the van.
Buy a used refrigerated cargo van and have it inspected
Get a mechanical inspection and test the refrigeration unit under load. Check mileage, service records and payload, and read the title for liens.
Register and title the van and buy commercial auto insurance
Register it in the business name. A CDL is needed only when the gross vehicle weight rating is 26,001 lb or more, which a standard cargo van is not.

cadenas.es: Permiso de ocupación de la vía pública
cadenas.propuesta_en: Upfit the van: shelving, load restraints and branding

cadenas.es: Si operas en espacio público fijo
cadenas.propuesta_en: Add racks, tie-downs and non-slip liners so loads cannot shift. A wrap helps marketing, but check that your insurer covers the upfit.
Buy general liability (or a business owner's policy) and order certificates of insurance

cadenas.es: Muchos mercados tienen lista de espera
cadenas.propuesta_en: Venues and planners ask for a certificate of insurance (COI) naming them as additional insured. Ask your broker for same-day COIs.
Add liquor liability if you serve alcohol the client buys
Skip it if no alcohol is served at your events. If your bartenders pour client-supplied alcohol, you need liquor liability and certified bartenders.

cadenas.es: Hojas de reclamaciones oficiales y su cartel anunciador
cadenas.propuesta_en: Buy workers' compensation coverage before your first hire

cadenas.es: También son obligatorias en venta ambulante: el modelo y el texto del cartel los aprueba tu Comunidad Autónoma
cadenas.propuesta_en: Required in almost every state once you have employees, including part-time event staff. Premiums depend on payroll and class code.

cadenas.es: Contrato con gestor autorizado de residuos y aceite usado
cadenas.propuesta_en: Arrange waste and grease removal with a licensed hauler

cadenas.es: Se comprueba en la inspección sanitaria del vehículo. Este mismo checklist ya avisa de que la freidora genera aceite usado que hay que gestionar, pero nunca contrataba el servicio
cadenas.propuesta_en: The commissary often handles it. Confirm who removes grease and trash for the van and what you must label, store and log.

cadenas.es: Contrato de desinsectación, desratización y desinfección (DDD)
cadenas.propuesta_en: Arrange pest control with a licensed company and post required notices

cadenas.es: Empresa inscrita en el ROESB; el certificado forma parte del plan APPCC móvil que ya exige la fase 4 de este checklist
cadenas.propuesta_en: Usually through the commissary. Keep service records and post the permit and any required notices where inspectors expect them.
List what you own versus what you rent for each service style

cadenas.es: Adaptar al concepto: burgers, crepes, plancha...
cadenas.propuesta_en: Drop-off, buffet, family-style, plated and stations need different equipment. Rent what you use rarely and buy what you use at nearly every event.
Buy chafing dishes, insulated carriers and calibrated thermometers

cadenas.es: Con filtro y gestión aceite usado
cadenas.propuesta_en: Choose insulated carriers that hold food hot or cold for the whole trip. Calibrate thermometers and keep spares in the van.
Buy portable cooking and power: induction, burners and a generator
Venues rarely have enough power for heavy cooking. Induction units are quiet and safer indoors; use a generator only where fire rules allow.
Stock hotel pans, sheet pans and utensils
Standardize on hotel pan sizes so everything stacks, travels and fits the carriers. Label pans and lids by station.
Buy serving and presentation pieces for chef-attended stations
Platters, risers, signage and a small tool kit per station. A consistent look is what makes your themed stations memorable in photos.

cadenas.es: Depósito de agua limpia y de aguas residuales
cadenas.propuesta_en: Open accounts with a broadline distributor (US Foods, Sysco) and a cash-and-carry such as Restaurant Depot

cadenas.es: Mínimo 40 L de agua limpia y 60 L de residual
cadenas.propuesta_en: Compare delivery minimums, credit terms and price lists. Restaurant Depot works well for small orders; broadline accounts cut costs as volume grows.
Line up specialty suppliers for your themed stations
Think of tortillas, proteins for carving, fresh pasta, fish for poke. Get quotes and delivery days from at least two suppliers per item.
Sign an agreement with a party rental company for tables, linens and dinnerware
Negotiate a caterer rate and standard delivery and pickup times. Rentals are billed to the client, so build them into your proposal.
Choose disposables and packaging for drop-off orders
Use compostable items where your city requires them. Test that hot food stays hot and that lids do not leak in a moving van.
Set up temperature logging for transport with a data logger
Place a logger in each carrier and in the van's cargo area. Save the report after every event as proof that food stayed in the safe zone.
Set up your commissary space: shelving, labeling and FIFO

cadenas.es: Primera impresión, marca visible a distancia
cadenas.propuesta_en: Label and date everything, and store first in, first out. Shared kitchens are inspected often, so a tidy, labeled space protects your permit.
Run a full dry run of an event with your team

cadenas.es: Kit de montaje rápido para cada servicio
cadenas.propuesta_en: Cook, pack, load, drive and set up for a mock event at a friend's venue. Time every step and fix what was slow before a client sees it.
Set a staffing plan per event by service style (servers per guest)
Buffets need fewer servers than plated dinners. Write a servers-per-guest ratio for each style and use it to price labor in every quote.
Build a pool of event staff on W-2 payroll, not 1099

cadenas.es: Contrato temporal o fijo-discontinuo para eventos
cadenas.propuesta_en: Event servers and bartenders are usually employees, not contractors (FLSA economic reality test; California AB5). Misclassification brings back wages and penalties.

cadenas.es: Formación en higiene alimentaria de todo el equipo
cadenas.propuesta_en: Prepare offer letters, I-9 and W-4 for each hire, and check state minimum wage

cadenas.es: El «carnet de manipulador» está derogado (RD 109/2010): la formación la acredita la EMPRESA y se documenta en el plan APPCC móvil
cadenas.propuesta_en: Complete Form I-9 within three business days of the start date and collect a W-4. Check state and local minimum wage and any minimum shift rules.
File new-hire reports with your state

cadenas.es: Temperaturas, cadena de frío en el vehículo y trazabilidad
cadenas.propuesta_en: Every state requires one, usually within 20 days. Most payroll providers file it for you automatically; confirm that yours does.
Set up a payroll provider and workers' comp on payroll

cadenas.es: Montaje, servicio rápido, desmontaje y limpieza
cadenas.propuesta_en: Connect payroll to your workers' comp policy so premiums follow actual hours. Set a clear pay schedule, including how event-night overtime is paid.
Get food handler cards for your whole team

cadenas.es: Riesgos específicos: gas, aceite, espacio reducido
cadenas.propuesta_en: Many states and counties require a food handler card for anyone handling food. Cards are cheap, online and valid for about 2-3 years.
Get alcohol server certification for your bartenders (TIPS, ServSafe Alcohol or TABC)

cadenas.es: 14 alérgenos, cartel visible en food truck
cadenas.propuesta_en: Required or strongly recommended where alcohol is served. Insurers often ask for it, and it is a selling point for planners and venues.
Cover OSHA basics: burns, lifting and driving safety
Train staff on hot pans, safe lifting and loading, and van driving. Keep an injury log and a first-aid kit in the van and at every event.

cadenas.es: Registro horario diario de la jornada de todo el equipo
cadenas.propuesta_en: Train service and event protocol: uniform, briefing and the nine major allergens

cadenas.es: Art. 34.9 del Estatuto de los Trabajadores; se conserva cuatro años. Aplica desde el primer contrato del ayudante, aunque sea a tiempo parcial
cadenas.propuesta_en: Run a pre-event briefing every time. Everyone should know the nine major allergens and how to hand an allergy question to the chef.

cadenas.es: Informar al equipo del registro horario y del tratamiento de sus datos
cadenas.propuesta_en: Set your service charge and gratuity policy

cadenas.es: La cláusula informativa se entrega con el contrato; el fichaje es un tratamiento de datos, no sólo una obligación laboral
cadenas.propuesta_en: A mandatory service charge is not a tip: the part paid out to staff is wages (IRS Rev. Rul. 2012-18). A gratuity is voluntary and goes to staff. Keep them on separate invoice lines and check your state's sales tax rule.
Create your brand, logo, themed station menu and professional photos
Photograph the stations, the plating and the team in action. Photos sell catering far better than menus, so invest here.
Build a website with menus, per-guest starting prices and a quote request form
Show packages by service style and a starting price per guest. A short form that asks for date, venue and guest count gets you better leads.
Set up your Google Business Profile and collect reviews

cadenas.es: Video del truck + comida = viral potencial
cadenas.propuesta_en: Pick the catering category and add your service area and photos. Ask every client for a review; local search brings many leads.

cadenas.es: Página web con el calendario de ubicaciones
cadenas.propuesta_en: Create profiles on The Knot and WeddingWire

cadenas.es: Dónde estarás cada día de la semana
cadenas.propuesta_en: Both are the main directories for wedding clients. Upload photos, list packages and answer inquiries within a few hours.
Join ezCater to reach corporate clients

cadenas.es: Comida en acción, truck rotulado, servicio
cadenas.propuesta_en: ezCater is a corporate catering marketplace that charges a commission on each order. Include that commission in your prices from the start.
Prospect corporate clients: office managers, HR and event planners
Build a list of nearby offices and drop off sample lunches. Repeat weekday orders make your base, so follow up every contact.

cadenas.es: Registro en apps de food trucks
cadenas.propuesta_en: Make agreements with venues and wedding planners (preferred vendor lists)

cadenas.es: Roaming Hunger, apps locales de street food
cadenas.propuesta_en: Ask each venue how to join its preferred list. Offer a tasting for the planner; their referrals turn into weekend bookings.
Define your tasting policy for prospects
Decide who gets a tasting, how many guests attend and whether the fee is credited toward the booking. Track the bookings each tasting produces.
Post event photos on Instagram and social media

cadenas.es: Primer servicio con promo: 2x1, redes, influencers
cadenas.propuesta_en: Share event photos with the client's permission. Use text or SMS for quick client follow-ups; keep inquiries in your CRM.
Create a proposal template with the kit calculator and track leads in your CRM

cadenas.es: Tarjeta digital o QR: el décimo menú, gratis
cadenas.propuesta_en: Your calculator gives the price per guest; the template turns it into a polished quote. Log every inquiry and follow up within 48 hours.

cadenas.es: Licencia de derechos de autor por música ambiental en ferias y festivales (SGAE/AGEDI-AIE)
cadenas.propuesta_en: Start a referral and review program for after each event

cadenas.es: Distinta de la licencia del organizador del festival, que cubre el recinto, no cada puesto individual
cadenas.propuesta_en: Send a thank-you message with a review link a day after the event. Offer something small to clients who refer a friend or a company.

cadenas.es: Cláusula informativa y consentimiento en el programa de fidelización con QR
cadenas.propuesta_en: Host a launch event or showcase for planners and companies

cadenas.es: El propio checklist promete un programa de fidelización móvil con QR que recoge datos de contacto: necesita su información previa
cadenas.propuesta_en: Invite planners, venue managers and office managers to a tasting of your stations. It is your best single day of sales.
Hold the client briefing at D-21: guests, diets and event timeline

cadenas.es: Evaluar facturación por ubicación y día
cadenas.propuesta_en: Confirm the guest count, dietary needs, service style, arrival time and who your contact is on the day. Send the summary in writing.
Visit the venue at D-14: access, kitchen, outlets and water

cadenas.es: Saber qué ubicaciones funcionan y cuáles no
cadenas.propuesta_en: Check loading access, parking, elevator, power, water and fire rules. Photograph the space and note where stations and chafers will go.
Order ingredients at D-7 and D-1 and write the production list

cadenas.es: Pesar el género, controlar mermas y ajustar pedidos
cadenas.propuesta_en: Order against the final guest count and add a small buffer. Build one production list with prep times and who does what.
Complete the loading and transport checklist with temperatures
Check carriers, pans, equipment and rentals against the list. Record food temperatures when you load and again when you arrive.
Set up 60-90 minutes before service and run the event

cadenas.es: Fijar los mejores días/ubicaciones como ruta fija
cadenas.propuesta_en: Arrive early, set up the stations and check hot and cold temperatures before guests arrive. Brief staff, then keep a service timeline.

cadenas.es: Encuestas a clientes y reseñas de Google
cadenas.propuesta_en: Pick up, clean and return rentals
Day of event or next morning
Count and inspect rentals before you leave. Return them clean by the agreed time to avoid late fees.
Send the final invoice within 48 hours; track deposits and balances

cadenas.es: Festivales = facturación x3-5 en un día
cadenas.propuesta_en: Private clients usually pay the balance 5-7 days before the event; invoice overages within 48 hours and follow corporate invoices on their 30-day terms.
Ask for a review and photos; follow up in your CRM

cadenas.es: Con volumen real, pedir mejores precios
cadenas.propuesta_en: Thank the client, share a review link and ask permission to use photos. Note preferences for the next booking.
Review food cost and labor per event against the calculator every week

cadenas.es: Comparar P&L real vs plan financiero
cadenas.propuesta_en: Compare actual food, staff hours and rentals with what the calculator projected. Small gaps add up quickly across a season.

cadenas.es: Plan de expansión (segundo truck o local fijo)
cadenas.propuesta_en: Do your 90-day review: price per guest, guest minimums and packages

cadenas.es: Si funciona, evaluar un segundo vehículo o un local fijo
cadenas.propuesta_en: Look at which events earned the most, which took too long and which packages sold. Adjust prices, minimums and offers.

cadenas.es: El contador de cada pestaña cuenta sólo las ✓; las N/A salen del total.
cadenas.propuesta_en: Each tab's counter counts only the ✓; N/A items come out of the total.
